content.user_title: Review Code with Structured AI Feedback
content.value_statement: Manual code review can miss bugs, style problems, and risky patterns when context is limited. This skill reviews provided code and returns prioritized issues, suggestions, a summary, and a quality score.
actual_capabilities: Identifies likely bugs such as null pointer risks, off-by-one errors, race conditions, and logic mistakes.
Reviews naming, organization, readability, and other style concerns in submitted code.
Flags performance concerns such as inefficient algorithms, unnecessary allocations, and N+1 query patterns.
Checks for security risks such as injection vulnerabilities, hardcoded secrets, and unsafe operations.
Returns issues with severity, line references, messages, suggestions, a summary, and a quality score.
limitations: Reviews only the code provided in the prompt; it does not scan repositories by itself.
Does not execute code, run tests, or prove that suggested fixes are correct.
Accuracy depends on the available context and the specified programming language.
Should not replace expert review for high-risk production changes.

use_cases.title: Pre-Merge Review
use_cases.description: Review a function or file before opening a pull request.

use_cases.title: Teaching Feedback
use_cases.description: Show learners bugs, style issues, and safer alternatives in example code.

use_cases.title: Security-Focused Triage
use_cases.description: Request a focused pass on risky code before deeper manual review.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Snippet
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for a small code sample.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this code for bugs, style, performance, and security. Language: [language]. Code: [paste code].

prompt_templates.title: Find Logic Bugs
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this code with focus set to bugs. Identify runtime errors, logic mistakes, and missing edge case handling. Code: [paste code].

prompt_templates.title: Check Security Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this code with focus set to security. Look for injection, hardcoded secrets, unsafe operations, and missing validation. Code: [paste code].

prompt_templates.title: Review Critical Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a senior-level review of this change. Prioritize correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. Include severity, line references, suggestions, summary, and score. Context: [brief context]. Code: [paste code].

output_examples.input: A JavaScript function searches a user list and returns a name.
output_examples.output: Reports an error for assignment used as comparison, an error for missing null handling, a warning for outdated variable use, and a low score.

output_examples.input: A database access method performs repeated queries inside a loop.
output_examples.output: Flags a performance issue for repeated database calls, suggests batching or eager loading, and summarizes the N+1 query risk.

output_examples.input: A login handler builds a database query from request text.
output_examples.output: Flags a security issue for possible injection, recommends parameterized queries, and lowers the quality score.

best_practices: Include enough surrounding code and expected behavior for meaningful review.
Set the focus field to bugs, style, performance, security, or all.
Verify suggested fixes with tests and project-specific review standards.
anti_patterns: Do not submit secrets, tokens, or production credentials for review.
Do not rely on the quality score alone to approve changes.
Do not review incomplete snippets without context when behavior matters.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews submitted source code for bugs, style issues, performance problems, and security risks.

faq.question: Does it run my code?
faq.answer: No. The skill reads provided code and returns review findings.

faq.question: Can it focus on security?
faq.answer: Yes. Set the focus to security to prioritize injection risks, hardcoded secrets, unsafe operations, and validation gaps.

faq.question: What languages are supported?
faq.answer: It can infer the language from code, but accuracy improves when you specify the language.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect structured issues with severity, line references, messages, suggestions, a summary, and a quality score.

faq.question: Is it a replacement for human review?
faq.answer: No. Use it as review support, then confirm findings with tests and project knowledge.
